decision.rationale: Unknown properties are permitted by the open request schema but rejected during binding. The retrieved CRUD tests do not exercise that scenario; §10.2 leaves the binding policy undecidable.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: TagsIntegrationTest hits assert GET/delete/create behavior, not PUT unknown-member handling. Tag has ordinary bindable properties and the inline schema is open; default binding policy remains ambiguous under §10.2.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
